performance_history.note: Graded on 2026-09-04. This is the newest published issue (issues #2-#7 were published Jun 26 through Aug 17 but never logged here; the state file had only tracked issue #1). At grading, publication showed 12 active subscribers (down from 14 at the issue-1 baseline), 0 net new and 0 churn over the trailing 7 days, and 0% aggregate open/click with $0 earnings for that window because no send went out in the last 7 days (last send was Aug 17, 18 days before this run). Issue #7 itself performed reasonably for a tiny list: ~31% open rate, 1 unique verified click, but a high 7.69% unsubscribe rate (1 of 13) worth watching.

ad_slots.note: Publication per-post ad cap (2 ads, matching issue #7) reached, so slot 3 was left as a labeled placeholder. Valid unused offers remained (e.g. Hubspot 206c, Superhuman AI 150c).

ad_placement_notes.lesson_2026-09-04: Embedding fresh list_ad_offers IDs failed twice: (1) three primary ads hit a per-post primary-slot cap ('No primary ad slot is available'); (2) 1 primary + 2 secondary hit 'can not accept any more opportunities' because the publication already had 4 accepted-but-unsent ad opportunities (created Sep 2-3) and could not accept new ones. Fix that worked: embed the already-ACCEPTED opportunity IDs from list_ad_opportunities(status=accepted) instead of raw offer IDs, and cap the post at 2 ads (1 primary + 1 secondary). Effective per-post ad cap for this publication appears to be 2.
